# Language

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Language`](gmeow-Language.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Language>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/language`](../../slices/language.md)

A language as a first-class information object with a self-minted IRI: a system of signs/symbols and rules used for communication or computation. Registry-INDEPENDENT — BCP-47/ISO 639/Glottolog/Wikidata are optional alignments ([`gmeow:languageCode`](../properties/gmeow-languageCode.md), [`gmeow:authorityLink`](../properties/gmeow-authorityLink.md), [skos:exactMatch](http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#exactMatch)), never identity, so a code-less conlang or AI-generated language is fully first-class. Origin, modality and status are open value vocabularies; the scripts it is written in are bound co-equally via [`gmeow:WritingSystemUsage`](gmeow-WritingSystemUsage.md); its endonym/exonym names are [`gmeow:Appellation`](gmeow-Appellation.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)
